Forewarned.name: Forewarned
Forewarned.description: The user catches the click of a safety, the scrape of a shoe or the breath drawn before a lunge. Until the start of the user's next turn, nobody can surprise the user or a person beside them, and the first attack aimed at either of them misses, because the user calls it out and gets them both out of the way in time. Strain: moderate.
